purpose: Teach: 土器/怪奇/輸血/波形/上演/決心/変数/駒

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業地から出土した、本気で、絶対、土器、絶対、当社、絶対、博物館で、絶対、展示しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The pottery we excavated from our founding site — I want it displayed in the museum. I'm serious about this. Make it happen.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding opening. Measured tempo with weight behind each clause. Direct eye contact. The tone of someone used to being obeyed, but not unkind about it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品、本気で、絶対、怪奇、絶対、なミステリー、絶対、シリーズ、絶対、好評です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our new mystery-series product line has been getting excellent feedback. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slightly forward-leaning posture. Clear diction. The careful cadence of someone reporting upward, choosing words with precision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 献血、本気for、絶対、輸血、絶対、キャンペーン、絶対、当社、絶対、協賛しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want our company to sponsor the blood-donation campaign. This is important to me. See that it's done.
lines.style: Firm conviction underneath the request. Slight pause after 'important'—letting the weight settle. Not aggressive, but unmistakably final.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の、本気で、絶対、波形、絶対、デザイン、絶対、お洒落と、絶対、評判です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. The new product line's wave-inspired design has been receiving compliments. We're grateful for your guidance.
lines.style: Steady, professional tone. Quiet confidence in the update. Not rushing. Eyes level. The rhythm of someone comfortable delivering good news.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 劇場主催の、本気で、絶対、上演、絶対、会、絶対、当社、絶対、協賛しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The theater production society is looking for sponsors. I've committed our company to support them. Handle the details.
lines.style: Declarative, already-decided tone. Not asking—informing. Brief pause between sentences. Economical phrasing. The voice of someone who settles matters and moves forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業の、本気で、絶対、決心、絶対、当社、絶対、固めてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've solidified our commitment to this new venture. We're grateful for your trust in us.
lines.style: Affirming, measured response. Slight lift on 'solidified'—suggesting weight and deliberation behind the decision. Calm, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 販売の、本気で、絶対、変数、絶対、見極めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Study our sales variables carefully. I need to know what's actually moving the numbers. Don't guess.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly on 'carefully.' Stern but not harsh. The emphasis falls on precision—he's asking for rigor, not just effort. Brief, unambiguous.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。将棋の、本気で、絶対、駒、絶対、デザインの、絶対、商品、絶対、人気です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The shogi-piece design product has become quite popular. We're proud of how well it's performing.
lines.style: Satisfied, closing note. Slightly warmer than previous updates. A touch of quiet pride in the delivery. Settling back—the rhythm of someone concluding.
